trigger.description: The exact pinned Transformers AutoBitLinear online-QAT path produced finite forward loss but immediate non-finite first-backward gradients in the untrained B_full control when the 1024-hidden smoke model inherited the BitNetConfig default initializer_range=0.02 without width scaling.

backward_boundary_localization.first_observed_nonfinite_boundary: backward propagation into layer-2 attention projections, followed by 6.25% non-finite activation gradients throughout layers 1 and 0
backward_boundary_localization.interpretation: depthwise backward explosion at initialization, not an EH1 causal effect

amended_rule.name: WIDTH_SCALED_MASTER_INIT_V1
amended_rule.application: BitNetConfig.initializer_range for all four matched arms before matched slicing/copying; deterministic EH1 energy projection uses the same smoke initializer range
amended_rule.pairing: all common tensors remain exact matched copies/slices of B_full within seed

source_rationale.bitnet_report: BitNet b1.58 2B4T reports forward-pass ternary absmean weight quantization, per-token int8 absmax activation quantization, SubLN, and native training from scratch.
source_rationale.foundation_transformer: The cited SubLN source explicitly couples Sub-LayerNorm with initialization designed for stable scaling. The public BitNet report does not expose the exact 2B4T training initializer implementation.
source_rationale.scaling_status: The width-scaling rule is therefore a documented Architecture-Smoke control inferred from the pinned reference configuration and first-backward preflight, not a claim about Microsoft's undisclosed production training recipe.

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not zero, clamp, or silently drop non-finite gradients.
Do not reinterpret the failed 0.02 initialization as an EH1 failure.
Do not claim WIDTH_SCALED_MASTER_INIT_V1 reproduces Microsoft's production initialization.
Do not compare arms initialized under different master-weight scaling rules.
